candidate_readme:
# Agent trace

Writes the agent loop as an OpenTelemetry trace so eval harnesses and operators can see what a run did, with timings and token accounting.

Load it with `pi -e examples/extensions/agent-trace` (or copy the directory to `~/.pi/agent/extensions/agent-trace/` / `.pi/extensions/agent-trace/` for `DefaultResourceLoader` discovery). No extra dependencies.

## File

Spans are appended as JSON Lines to:

```text
<SessionManager.getSessionDir()>/traces/<session id>.otlp.jsonl
```

`PI_AGENT_TRACE_FILE`, when set, replaces that path. The directory is created on demand. `/reload` and a later process resuming the session append to the same file.

Each line is one OTLP/JSON `ExportTraceServiceRequest` holding exactly one span:

```json
{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"attributes":[...]},"scopeSpans":[{"scope":{"name":"pi.agent-trace","version":"1"},"spans":[<span>]}]}]}
```

Resource attributes: `service.name` = `"pi"`, `service.version` = the coding-agent package version, `pi.session.id`, `process.pid`.

A span is written twice: a **start** line (no `endTimeUnixNano` / `status`, attribute `pi.span.phase` = `"start"`) at the event that starts it, then an **end** line with the same `traceId` / `spanId` / `parentSpanId` / `name` / `kind` / `startTimeUnixNano` once the span has ended and its remaining attributes are known. De-duplicate by `spanId`; last line wins. A start without an end is in progress (or was lost to a crash).

## Spans

| name | kind | parent | starts / ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pi.run` | INTERNAL (1) | none | `agent_start` / `agent_end` |
| `pi.turn` | INTERNAL (1) | the run | `turn_start` / `turn_end` |
| `chat <model>` | CLIENT (3) | the turn | assistant `message_start` / first `tool_execution_start`, or `turn_end` when the turn calls no tool |
| `execute_tool <tool name>` | INTERNAL (1) | the turn | `tool_execution_start` / `turn_end` (one span per concurrent call) |
| `pi.compaction` | INTERNAL (1) | none | `session_before_compact` / `session_compact` or `session_compact_failed` |

Run trigger is `"prompt"` (a `before_agent_start` preceded the start), `"continuation"` (start before the previous run's `agent_settled`), or `"wakeup"` (idle `sendMessage` with `triggerTurn`). Steering messages consumed during a run are listed on the run as `pi.run.steer_count` / `pi.run.steer_entry_ids`; they start a new turn in the same run.

Status is ERROR for a tool with `isError`, an assistant `stopReason` of `error` or `aborted` (and that turn), a failed compaction, and every span still open on `session_shutdown` (message `shutdown`). Runs stay OK even when a turn failed.

A write failure is reported once per process as a `customType: "agent-trace"` message (`triggerTurn: false`) whose text starts with `agent-trace: cannot write`, and does not stop later spans from being written if the path recovers.
